sys_script_include.description: Base class and shared helpers for LLM providers. Contract (see docs/DESIGN.md section 4.1): generateStructured(request) -> { data, text, usage, stopReason, model, cost } generateText(request) -> { text, usage, stopReason, model, cost } healthCheck() -> { ok, message } estimateCost(usage) -> Number request = { purpose, system, messages: [{role, content}], schema, maxTokens, effort, jobId, template } Errors thrown by providers carry .retryable (Boolean), .retryAfter (seconds) and .status.
sys_script_include.name: LLMProvider
